## NSTelemetryMetrics interface

Player-defined OpenTelemetry metrics API (ns.telemetry.metrics.\*).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface NSTelemetryMetrics 
```

## Remarks

Define a metric by name on first use, then update it with subsequent calls. The attributes object is your set of dimensions. Metrics export through the stdout/stderr and/or OTLP sinks (not the in-game console). No-op when telemetry is disabled.
